key_claims.claim: Co-occurring stimulant or polysubstance use with anxiety/depression in pregnancy substantially increases hypertensive disorders and adverse maternal-neonatal outcomes compared to mental health diagnosis alone
Episiotomy during operative vaginal delivery is associated with higher odds of obstetric anal sphincter injury, with effect modification by OVD type and parity
Intertwin umbilical venous diameter and flow differences reflect placental sharing and independently predict adverse outcomes in MCDA-sFGR beyond UA Doppler alone
UA Doppler-based sFGR classification in MCDA twins stratifies severity but has limited discriminatory performance for adverse outcomes beyond established markers
Cervicovaginal IL-6 combined with cervical ultrasound characteristics matches or exceeds fFN for preterm delivery prediction in threatened PTL
